# Synthetic fixtures only

All CSV records in this directory and all rows generated by test helpers are synthetic.
They exercise ingestion/quality behavior and are not a real dataset, benchmark, performance
claim or source for the application's default profile. Smoke outputs belong in `.tools/`
or a temporary directory, never the default real-data artifact location.

`synthetic_ieee_transaction.csv` and `synthetic_ieee_identity.csv` imitate column structure
only. Their labels, device strings, keys and values are invented test records, not Kaggle
measurements. Tests include unmatched/orphan keys and matched records with blank attributes.
